title: File manager
pick_hint: Select files on either side (right-click or Ctrl+click), then send them
copied: Copied {{count}} item(s) to the other side
moved: Moved {{count}} item(s) to the other side
send_folders_hint: Folders can't be sent. Compress them first.
restricted: Android blocks access to other apps' Android/data and Android/obb folders.
device_password_required: Phone storage is only available on the web when the web access password is on (Settings → Web server).
device_permission_required: Grant "All files access" in the app first (File manager on the phone).
workspaces_read_only: Workspace folders themselves can't be changed here; open one to work with its files
file_locked: This file holds content locked as final; change or unlock it in the app
